questions: If a route goes from Circle to Madina, is the fare the same for going back from Madina to Circle, or should each direction be its own route with its own fare?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, perhaps with a password, while passengers can only look up fares?
When a fare goes up, do you want to keep a record of the old fares and when they changed, or just replace the old fare with the new one?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
